title: Income from House Property — Annual Value, Deductions and Co-ownership

content.overview: House-property income is the owner's annual value after municipal taxes and the section 24 deductions. Co-owners are taxed on their shares. A property used for the owner's business is not in this head. Self-occupied treatment is limited to the properties the section allows. The computation is statutory. Actual expenses other than the enacted deductions are not allowed.

essentialIngredients: Municipal taxes borne by the owner
enhancement.detailedExplanation: Deemed ownership in section 27 includes specified transfers to a spouse or minor and possession under a part-performance contract. That deeming is applied before the tenant is treated as the taxpayer. The standard deduction is a percentage of annual value. Interest is actual interest payable, subject to the self-occupied cap. Arrears of rent are taxed as enacted when received.
examples: Each is assessed on the owned share.
A person in possession under a section 53A contract is checked against section 27 before the legal owner is charged.
